name: macbook
description: Diagnose MacBook heat, memory pressure, and disk headroom as three separate questions.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose MacBook heat, memory, and storage
interface.longDescription: Three separate diagnoses for a MacBook under strain: what is burning CPU and causing fan spin, how close physical memory is to OOM, and where disk space went. Read-only snapshots first, least-destructive cleanup last.
defaultPrompt: Why is my MacBook hot and loud?
How close am I to running out of RAM?
Where did my disk space go?
